title: The glow filter
blurb: Probably the most famous dupe on the internet. A glowy, blurring liquid you wear under foundation, mixed in, or alone for a soft-focus finish.

title: The liquid blush
viral: Rare Beauty Soft Pinch Liquid Blush
blurb: A tiny dot goes a long way with both. Highly pigmented, blendable cheek colour for that flushed, just-pinched look.
cta: A tiny dot goes a long way

title: The lip oil
blurb: Glossy, cushiony lip oil with a hint of tint. The NYX version is a fan favourite for the same juicy shine.

title: The skinny brow pencil
blurb: An ultra-fine tip for hair-like strokes. Perfect for sharp, sculpted arches that frame your whole face.

title: The lengthening mascara
viral: Too Faced Better Than Sex Mascara
blurb: Long, lifted, fluttery lashes. Sky High went viral for its flexible brush and serious length.

title: The setting powder
viral: Laura Mercier Translucent Loose Setting Powder
blurb: A finely milled powder to lock makeup in place and blur shine. Airspun has been a cult classic for decades.
cta: A cult classic for a reason

title: The gripping primer
blurb: A sticky, hydrating gel primer that helps makeup grip and last all day. The e.l.f. version sold out repeatedly when it went viral.

title: The pore-blurring primer
blurb: A velvety balm-like primer that smooths the look of pores and gives a soft, silky base.

title: The full-coverage concealer
blurb: Big doe-foot applicator, serious coverage. The e.l.f. Camo concealer is one of the most talked-about drugstore dupes ever.

title: The highlighter wand
dupe: e.l.f. Halo Glow Highlight Beauty Wand
blurb: A cushion-tip wand for a dewy, lit-from-within glow on cheekbones, brow bones and the bridge of the nose.

title: The contour wand
dupe: e.l.f. Halo Glow Contour Beauty Wand
blurb: A cushion-tip cream contour that blends out easily for soft, sculpted definition.

title: The bronzing drops
blurb: Mix a few drops into moisturizer or foundation for a warm, sun-kissed glow, all year round.

title: The tinted brow gel
viral: Benefit Gimme Brow+ Volumizing Brow Gel
blurb: Tinted, fibre-filled brow gel that adds volume and holds brows in place in seconds.

title: The cult bronzer
blurb: A soft, buildable bronzer for warmth and gentle sculpting. The Butter Bronzer is a long-time drugstore favourite.

title: The setting spray
viral: Urban Decay All Nighter Setting Spray
dupe: e.l.f. Stay All Night Micro-Fine Setting Mist
blurb: A fine mist that locks makeup in place so it lasts from morning coffee to last call.

title: The overnight lip mask
blurb: Slather it on before bed and wake up to soft, smooth lips. The e.l.f. version is a fan-favourite budget swap.

title: The buttery lip balm
blurb: A cushiony, glossy balm in a squeeze tube. Beauty shoppers love the e.l.f. one for the same buttery feel.

title: The cult lip gloss
blurb: A non-sticky, high-shine gloss that flatters everyone. NYX Butter Gloss is a long-time drugstore favourite.

title: The iconic powder blush
blurb: A peachy-pink blush with a soft golden shimmer. Luminoso has been called the go-to dupe for years.

title: The blush wand
viral: Charlotte Tilbury Matte Beauty Blush Wand
dupe: e.l.f. Halo Glow Blush Beauty Wand
blurb: A cushion-tip liquid blush that blends out in seconds for a soft, rosy flush.

title: The hydrating primer
blurb: A lightweight, hydrating primer that gives skin a fresh, dewy base before makeup.

title: The airbrush powder
viral: Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Finish Powder
blurb: A finely milled pressed powder that softens the look of pores and sets makeup with a blurred finish.

title: The brow lamination gel
blurb: A clear, sculpting wax that brushes brows up and holds them all day for a fluffy, laminated look.

title: The felt-tip liner
blurb: A fine brush-tip liquid liner for crisp, inky wings. Epic Ink is one of the best-loved drugstore liners.

title: The lifting mascara
blurb: Lifts, lengthens and separates without clumping. The L'Oreal formula is a popular budget pick.

title: The creamy concealer
dupe: Maybelline Instant Age Rewind Eraser Concealer
blurb: A creamy, brightening concealer with a sponge tip. The Maybelline Eraser has been a bestseller for years.
